integrity.canonicalSource: direct baseline trades; no detector replay

methodology.purpose: Counterfactual audit of reversing every canonical BUY/SELL direction while preserving each trade entry and mirroring its original SL/TP distances.
methodology.entry: Original canonical baseline entry price and entryIndex are unchanged.
methodology.direction: BUY becomes SELL; SELL becomes BUY.
methodology.riskReward: Original absolute stop distance and target distance are mirrored around the same entry.
methodology.path: Future 5min OHLC candles after entry are scanned until mirrored SL or TP is touched.
methodology.ambiguity: If mirrored SL and TP are both touched in the same candle, outcome is AMBIGUOUS and excluded from performance statistics.
methodology.openEnd: If neither level is touched before the dataset ends, outcome is OPEN_END and excluded.
methodology.warning: This is a counterfactual diagnostic, not a production strategy or a claim that simply inverting the signal is valid.
